feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Rep. Haley Stevens endorses Abdul El-Sayed's GOP challenger in Michigan race
entry.summary: After losing the Michigan Democratic Senate primary to Abdul El-Sayed, Congresswoman Haley Stevens revoked her endorsement of him Sunday and threw her support behind his Republican opponent.

entry.title: Rep. Debbie Dingell reacts to Rep. Haley Stevens, D-Mich., endorsing GOP candidate
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks to Democratic Congresswoman Debbie Dingell of Michigan about Senate candidate Dr. Abdul El-Sayed losing the endorsement of his primary opponent Rep. Haley Stevens.

entry.title: How 2 GOP incumbents in Pennsylvania are approaching the midterms and Trump
entry.summary: Two Republican incumbents in competitive districts in Pennsylvania are adopting different campaign approaches when it comes to President Trump.

entry.title: How does this fluoride-free toothpaste compare when it comes to oral health?
entry.summary: Many people are swapping out their fluoride dental products for ones made with a mineral called hydroxyapatite. What do dentists say about it?

entry.title: With students scarce, college admissions offices get friendlier, less intimidating
entry.summary: Colleges are trying to transform an admissions process that has often been daunting, secretive and stressful into an experience that's open, easier — and downright friendly.

entry.title: What Vance's midterm push reveals about his potential 2028 bid
entry.summary: Vance's delivery is different from the president's but his speeches contain plenty of MAGA DNA.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Democratic Rep. Haley Stevens endorses GOP candidate in Michigan race, key races remain close in last day before midterm election, Gulf states concerned about possible U.S. attack on Iran.

entry.title: Bill Hader talks about his latest role as 'The Cat in the Hat'
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez talks to Bill Hader, who stars as "The Cat in the Hat" in the latest film adaptation of Dr. Seuss's beloved book.

entry.title: Hundreds evacuate city during temporary ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine
entry.summary: The ceasefire in a Russian-occupied Ukrainian city has ended. The ceasefire, which lasted several days, allowed hundreds of residents to evacuate.

entry.title: FBI says North Korean hackers are behind the theft of $6.3B from Binance
entry.summary: The FBI is attributing the theft of $6.3 billion from the Binance cryptocurrency exchange to North Korean hackers. North Korea has prioritized cyber operations and built a formidable cyber force.
